reviewMethod: Official May 2026 TZ1-TZ3 questions: a source-grounded primary pass from the question crop and official markscheme, a separate blind second pass from sealed evidence without the primary labels or the Drex triage scores, and a written adjudication of every row where the passes differ (primary, secondaries, official codes, status) or either was low-confidence. Drex (drex-v1.1 requests, answered by drex-v1.5) was used for triage only.

rows.adjudication: Functional-group identification is O2 with Structure 3.2 (2025 tz3 Paper 1A functional-groups rows are filed under Functional groups and reactions).
Mole ratio of the balanced equation applied to gas volumes: reacting quantities (M3) with codes Reactivity 2.1 and Structure 1.5 (Avogadro); no independent second concept.
Identifying Br- as a Lewis base is acid-base behaviour (C1, Reactivity 3.4); the guide's ambiguity rule gives C when acid-base behaviour is assessed, not O (no mechanism is assessed).
Group number from successive ionization energies: periodic trends (A3, Structure 3.1), as the 2025 tz2 successive-ionization-energy row.
Charge of an iron(II) aqua-hydroxo complex from ligand charges: complex ions (A4, Structure 3.1); the oxidation state is given, so no redox reasoning is credited.
Recognising a coordinate bond: Lewis/bonding model (B2, Structure 2.2), as the 2025 Nov tz1 coordination-bond row.

Data-based Dead Sea question: experimental design/variables/evaluation (a iv, b i, b iv, c i, c ii, c iv) carry about 11 of 25 marks, more than graph reading and processing (D2, about 6), calibration (3) or uncertainty (1).
